description: This file provides the implementation of an OpenAI Language Model (LLM) service with context aggregation support. It defines classes for creating context aggregators tailored for OpenAI's message format, handles function call management, image handling, and deprecation notices for legacy classes. The classes enable integration with OpenAI's API, support context management, and facilitate communication of function call states and image data.

classes.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated pair of context aggregators for user and assistant messages, wrapping respective aggregator instances for OpenAI message processing.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: An implementation of the OpenAI LLM service, providing context aggregator creation and configuration.

classes.name: OpenAIUserContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific aggregator for user messages, inherits from LLMUserContextAggregator.

classes.name: OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific aggregator for assistant messages, handles functions, tool usage, and images.

methods.name: "OpenAIUserContextAggregator" user(self)
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: "OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator" assistant(self)
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair create_context_aggregator( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
methods.description: Creates OpenAI-specific context aggregators for user and assistant messages, handling deprecation in favor of a universal context.

methods.name: handle_function_call_in_progress(self, frame: FunctionCallInProgressFrame)
methods.description: Handles an ongoing function call, updating the context with in-progress status.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result(self, frame: FunctionCallResultFrame)
methods.description: Handles the completion of a function call, updating the context with the result.

methods.name: handle_function_call_cancel(self, frame: FunctionCallCancelFrame)
methods.description: Handles cancellation of a function call, updating the context accordingly.

methods.name: _update_function_call_result( self, function_name: str, tool_call_id: str, result: Any )
methods.description: Internal method to update the context with the result or status of a function call.

methods.name: handle_user_image_frame(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: Processes a user image frame, marking related function calls as completed and adding the image to the context.

ctags.name: create_context_aggregator
ctags.signature: ( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
